_doc: FireRedHD slice a5.4: the FireRed/LeafGreen soundtrack data, layered over the Hoenn RSE->Black 2 conversion.
The M4A engine and the Black 2 instrument library / calibration (data/hoenn_music.json 'defaults'/'roles'/'noise'/
'drums' and data/hoenn_music_levels.json) are reused unchanged; only what differs for FireRed is declared here:
defaults: GBA sample names that exist only in FireRed (pokefirered's direct_sound_data.inc labels), each mapped
to a Black 2 instrument program (a measured id from hoenn_music_levels.json 'programs'). Pallet Town and Route 1
use four names RSE never had; the rest of the FRLG samples share RSE's labels and need no entry here.
slots / songs are added when the songs are installed into swan_sound_data.sdat (the follow-on steps): 'slots' maps
each FRLG song to the Black 2 sequence slot it takes over, 'songs' holds per-song instrument/volume overrides.
Program choices for the pianos/e-piano/whistle are the closest measured keyboard/wind timbres; the on-screen result
is what the user tunes (no emulator here, so these are a starting point, not a claim the mix is final).
